<table border="0" align="center" style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
  <tr>
    <td>
    With the <b>{format:auto}</b> tag it is possible to define data for later use.
</td>
  </tr>
</table>


<p>
  <table border="1" cellpadding="10" cellspacing="0" class="pad-play-box">
    <tr>
      
      
      
      <th bgcolor="#dddddd">HTML</th>
      <th bgcolor="#dddddd">RESULT<link rel="stylesheet" href="/pad/_common/play.css?v=0710b25258"><a class="pad-play" href="/pad/wasm/#" title="Try it in WASM" aria-label="Try this example in WASM"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="pad-icon pad-icon-play" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7Z"/></svg></a><a class="pad-play pad-live" href="/pad/live/#" title="Run it live, as a page of this server" aria-label="Run this example as a page of this server"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="pad-icon pad-icon-zap" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M13.5 2.5L5 13.5h6.5l-1 8 8.5-11h-6.5Z"/></svg></a></th>
    </tr>
    
  <tr><td style="vertical-align:top"><!-- START DEMO SOURCE --><pre><code style="color: #000000"><b>{<font color="blue"><font color="purple">format</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>auto </font><font color="red"><font color="black">'</font>myData<font color="black">'</font></font>}</b><br>  [<br>    { "name": "joe",   "phone": "555-3425" },<br>    { "name": "jim",   "phone": "555-2364" },<br>    { "name": "jack",  "phone": "555-3422" },<br>    { "name": "jerry", "phone": "555-4973" }<br>  ]<br><b>{/<font color="blue"><font color="purple">format</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>auto</font><font color="red"></font>}</b><br><br>    &lt;table border="1"&gt;<br>      <b>{<font color="blue"><font color="purple">data</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>myData</font><font color="red"></font>}</b><br>        &lt;tr&gt;<br>          &lt;td&gt;<b>{<font color="green"><font color="red">$</font>name</font>}</b>&lt;/td&gt;<br>          &lt;td&gt;<b>{<font color="green"><font color="red">$</font>phone</font>}</b>&lt;/td&gt;<br>        &lt;/tr&gt;<br>      <b>{/<font color="blue"><font color="purple">data</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>myData</font><font color="red"></font>}</b><br>    &lt;/table&gt;</code></pre><!-- END DEMO SOURCE --></td><td style="vertical-align:top"><code><span style="color: #000000"><!-- START DEMO RESULT --><table border="1">
      
        <tr>
          <td>joe</td>
          <td>555-3425</td>
        </tr>
      
        <tr>
          <td>jim</td>
          <td>555-2364</td>
        </tr>
      
        <tr>
          <td>jack</td>
          <td>555-3422</td>
        </tr>
      
        <tr>
          <td>jerry</td>
          <td>555-4973</td>
        </tr>
      
    </table><!-- END DEMO RESULT --></span></code></td></tr>

  </table>
</p>

<table border="0" align="center" style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
  <tr>
    <td>
  Data can be in xml/json/yaml/csv format.
  <br><br>
  There is also an own PAD list format with opening ( and closing )
  </p>
</td>
  </tr>
</table>


<p>
  <table border="1" cellpadding="10" cellspacing="0" class="pad-play-box">

    </tr>
    
  <tr><td style="vertical-align:top"><!-- START DEMO SOURCE --><pre><code style="color: #000000"><b>{<font color="blue"><font color="purple">format</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>auto </font><font color="red"><font color="black">'</font>myXML<font color="black">'</font></font>}</b><br>  &lt;data&gt;<br>    &lt;row name="bob"   phone="555-1111" /&gt;<br>    &lt;row name="jim"   phone="555-2222" /&gt;<br>    &lt;row name="joe"   phone="555-3333" /&gt;<br>    &lt;row name="jerry" phone="555-4444" /&gt;<br>  &lt;/data&gt;<br><b>{/<font color="blue"><font color="purple">format</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>auto</font><font color="red"></font>}</b><br><br>    <b>{<font color="blue"><font color="purple">format</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>auto </font><font color="red"><font color="black">'</font>myJSON<font color="black">'</font></font>}</b><br>  [ { "name": "bob",   "phone": "555-5555" },<br>    { "name": "jim",   "phone": "555-6666" },<br>    { "name": "joe",   "phone": "555-7777" },      <br>    { "name": "jerry", "phone": "555-8888" } ]<br><b>{/<font color="blue"><font color="purple">format</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>auto</font><font color="red"></font>}</b><br><br>    <b>{<font color="blue"><font color="purple">format</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>auto </font><font color="red"><font color="black">'</font>myYAML<font color="black">'</font></font>}</b><br>  ---<br>  - name: bob<br>    phone: 555-3425<br>  - name: jim<br>    phone: 555-4364<br>  - name: joe<br>    phone: 555-3422<br>  - name: jerry<br>    phone: 555-4973<br><b>{/<font color="blue"><font color="purple">format</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>auto</font><font color="red"></font>}</b><br><br>    <b>{<font color="blue"><font color="purple">format</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>auto </font><font color="red"><font color="black">'</font>myCSV<font color="black">'</font></font>}</b><br>  name,phone<br>  bob,555-3425<br>  jim,555-4364<br>  joe,555-3422<br>  jerry,555-4973<br><b>{/<font color="blue"><font color="purple">format</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>auto</font><font color="red"></font>}</b><br><br>    <b>{<font color="blue"><font color="purple">format</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>auto </font><font color="red"><font color="black">'</font>myList<font color="black">'</font></font>}</b><br>  ( 'myXML', 'myJSON', 'myYAML', 'myCSV' )<br><b>{/<font color="blue"><font color="purple">format</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>auto</font><font color="red"></font>}</b></code></pre><!-- END DEMO SOURCE --></td><td style="vertical-align:top"><code><span style="color: #000000"><!-- START DEMO RESULT --><!-- END DEMO RESULT --></span></code></td></tr>
  <tr><td style="vertical-align:top"><!-- START DEMO SOURCE --><pre><code style="color: #000000"><b>{<font color="blue"><font color="purple">data</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>myList</font><font color="red"></font>}</b><br>      &lt;p&gt;<br>        &lt;table border=1&gt;<br>          &lt;tr&gt;<br>            &lt;th colspan="2"&gt;<br>              <b>{<font color="green"><font color="red">$</font>myList</font>}</b><br>            &lt;/th&gt;<br>          &lt;/tr&gt;<br>          <b>{<font color="blue"><font color="purple">pad</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>pad </font><font color="red">data=<font color="black">'</font><b><font color="black">{</font><font color="green"><font color="red"><font color="red">$</font></font>myList</font><font color="black">}</font></b><font color="black">'</font></font>}</b><br>            &lt;tr&gt;<br>              &lt;td&gt;<b>{<font color="green"><font color="red">$</font>name</font>}</b>&lt;/td&gt;<br>              &lt;td&gt;<b>{<font color="green"><font color="red">$</font>phone</font>}</b>&lt;/td&gt;<br>            &lt;/tr&gt;<br>          <b>{/<font color="blue"><font color="purple">pad</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>pad</font><font color="red"></font>}</b><br>        &lt;/table&gt;<br>      &lt;/p&gt;<br>    <b>{/<font color="blue"><font color="purple">data</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>myList</font><font color="red"></font>}</b></code></pre><!-- END DEMO SOURCE --></td><td style="vertical-align:top"><code><span style="color: #000000"><!-- START DEMO RESULT --><p>
        <table border=1>
          <tr>
            <th colspan="2">
              myXML
            </th>
          </tr>
          
            <tr>
              <td>bob</td>
              <td>555-1111</td>
            </tr>
          
            <tr>

              <td>555-2222</td>
            </tr>
          
            <tr>

            </tr>
          
            <tr>

              <td>555-4444</td>
            </tr>
          
        </table>

      <p>

          <tr>

      <p>

            <tr>

            <tr>

<table border="0" align="center" style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
  <tr>
    <td>
  <p>
If <b>{format:auto 'xxx'}</b> is used, then the data will not be processed before it is stored in the data store,<br>all above examples use it in this way.</p>
  <p>
    If <b>{/format:auto 'xxx'}</b> is used, then the data will be processed before it is stored in the data store.<br> Below a crazy example how this can be used: <br>
- first there is a JSON data definition<br>
- then this JSON data is converted to CSV data<br>
- then this CSV data is converted to XML data<br>
- then this XML data is converted to YAML data<br>
- then this YAML data is used to show a HTML table.
</td>
  </tr>
</table>

    </tr>
